nodeSqliteSeam.originalClaim: Upstream packaging check misclassifies node:sqlite as an external dependency; a Horca overlay is needed.
nodeSqliteSeam.whyRetracted: The claim was produced under Node v22.23.2, which does not satisfy Orca's declared engines.node=24. module.builtinModules gained prefix-only builtins (node:sqlite, node:test) in Node 23.5.0; Node 24 includes them.
nodeSqliteSeam.conclusion: Under the supported Node 24 runtime upstream classifies node:sqlite and node:test correctly. No overlay is needed. The existing Horca patch is legacy patch archaeology, not a new-architecture seam.
nodeSqliteSeam.actionTaken: No overlay added. No patch preserved on the basis of this finding.

localEnvironmentBlocker.originalClaim: node-pty native rebuild fails on this host because MacOSX27.0.sdk .tbd files declare arm64e.x1, blocking Gate A packaging.
localEnvironmentBlocker.rootCause: The active Xcode linker was older than the SDK in use. Earlier the machine's xcode-select pointed at Xcode 26.6 (ld-1267), which cannot parse the MacOSX27.0 SDK's arm64e.x1 entries. During the session it moved to Xcode 27.0 RC (ld-27037.1), which can.
localEnvironmentBlocker.conclusion: Machine Xcode/SDK configuration, not a Horca or upstream defect. No Horca workaround required. A coherent Xcode/SDK pair (or clean CI) is the environment requirement.
localEnvironmentBlocker.actionTaken: No workaround added to Horca. Recorded as LOCAL_ENVIRONMENT_INCOMPATIBLE.
